CustomEvent and dispatchEvent

CustomEvent carries application-defined event data in detail. dispatchEvent synchronously dispatches an
event to registered listeners; bubbling is opt-in for a new CustomEvent.
Application එJක්ම event name එකක් හදාJගෙන detail එJකන් data යවන්න පුළුවන්. dispatchEvent() call කරද්දී handlers synchronous Jලස run Jවනවා. Parent එකට bubble කරන්න bubbles:true Jදන්න.
